verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.

xrefs.text: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
I have blotted out your transgressions like a cloud, and your sins like a mist. Return to Me, for I have redeemed you.
I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!

verses.text: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

xrefs.text: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
and since we have a great priest over the house of God,
I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.
Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts within you?

verses.text: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

xrefs.text: He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
For our transgressions are multiplied before You, and our sins testify against us. Our transgressions are indeed with us, and we know our iniquities:
Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.

verses.text: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.

xrefs.text: Then David said to Nathan, “I have sinned against the LORD.” “The LORD has taken away your sin,” Nathan replied. “You will not die.
The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.
Then God said to Abimelech in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against Me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
No one in this house is greater than I am. He has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. So how could I do such a great evil and sin against God?”
Certainly not! Let God be true and every man a liar. As it is written: “So that You may be proved right when You speak and victorious when You judge.”

verses.text: Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.

xrefs.text: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, so also death was passed on to all men, because all sinned.
Who can bring out clean from unclean? No one!
The wicked are estranged from the womb; the liars go astray from birth.
What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
All of us also lived among them at one time, fulfilling the cravings of our flesh and indulging its desires and thoughts. Like the rest, we were by nature children of wrath.

verses.text: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

xrefs.text: But the LORD said to Samuel, “Do not consider his appearance or height, for I have rejected him; the LORD does not see as man does. For man sees the outward appearance, but the LORD sees the heart.”
He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
but from the inner disposition of your heart, the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is precious in God’s sight.
For in my inner being I delight in God’s law.
Who has put wisdom in the heart or given understanding to the mind?

verses.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

xrefs.text: But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
“Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.
For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,

Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there. He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone, a grave, or a person who has died or been slain.

For when Moses had proclaimed every commandment of the law to all the people, he took the blood of calves and goats, along with water, scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled the scroll and all the people,

verses.text: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.

xrefs.text: Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
Blessed indeed is the man whom God corrects; so do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.

verses.text: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.

xrefs.text: For My eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from My face, and their guilt is not concealed from My eyes.
Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!

For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. When Nathan the prophet came to him after his adultery with Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your loving devotion; according to Your great compassion, blot out my transgressions.
Surely for my own welfare I had such great anguish; but Your love has delivered me from the pit of oblivion, for You have cast all my sins behind Your back.

verses.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

xrefs.text: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
to put off your former way of life, your old self, which is being corrupted by its deceitful desires;
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
Cast away from yourselves all the transgressions you have committed, and fashion for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why should you die, O house of Israel?

verses.text: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me.

xrefs.text: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

But the LORD was gracious to Israel and had compassion on them, and He turned toward them because of His covenant with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. And to this day, the LORD has been unwilling to destroy them or cast them from His presence.
But they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit. So He turned and became their enemy, and He Himself fought against them.
You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
So the LORD said, “My Spirit will not contend with man forever, for he is mortal; his days shall be 120 years.”

verses.text: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, and sustain me with a willing spirit.

xrefs.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

I will rejoice greatly in the LORD, my soul will exult in my God; for He has clothed me with garments of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom wears a priestly headdress, as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
Now to Him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present you unblemished in His glorious presence, with great joy—
Now the Lord is the Spirit, and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

verses.text: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.

xrefs.text: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.
My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,
Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,
When they had finished eating, Jesus asked Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these? “Yes, Lord, he answered, “You know I love You. Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.

to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those sanctified by faith in Me.

verses.text: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.

xrefs.text: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.

Why then have you despised the command of the LORD by doing evil in His sight? You put Uriah the Hittite to the sword and took his wife as your own. You have slain him with the sword of the Ammonites.
Therefore I testify to you this day that I am innocent of the blood of all men.
Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed; for in His own image God has made mankind.

verses.text: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

xrefs.text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
that I may declare all Your praises— that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth to speak among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.

verses.text: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.

xrefs.text: For I desire mercy, not sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than burnt offerings.
Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.

But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.
Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

verses.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.

xrefs.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
Has not My hand made all these things? And so they came into being,” declares the LORD. “This is the one I will esteem: he who is humble and contrite in spirit, who trembles at My word.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.
and to love Him with all your heart and with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself. This is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.

verses.text: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

xrefs.text: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.
For I will be a wall of fire around it, declares the LORD, and I will be the glory within it.’”
He predestined us for adoption as His sons through Jesus Christ, according to the good pleasure of His will,
Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.

verses.text: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.

xrefs.text: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver. Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness.
and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
